# external/

The one outside dataset, used in the Best Bias Discovery only, never in a scored submission.

`osm_fire_stations_2026-10-31.geojson`: OpenStreetMap `amenity=fire_station` in the five study-region
bounding boxes, retrieved 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC from the Overpass API. 3,798 stations.

© OpenStreetMap contributors. Available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
The query to fetch it again is in [docs/data.md](../docs/data.md).
